title: Clone — RLS end-state snapshot
description: Expected end-state of RLS policies, storage bucket visibility, and security triggers after applying every migration in supabase/migrations. Regenerate with `node scripts/check-rls.mjs --update-snapshot` (or `npm run check:rls:update-snapshot`) after an intentional, reviewed policy change.

policies.description: Keyed by '<schema>.<table>'. Each table maps to an array of policy descriptors.

buckets.description: Storage bucket id -> whether the bucket is public-read.

triggers.description: Security trigger name -> table it is attached to.
